meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 扫描项目里未使用的导入、常量、函数、参数和孤立文件,用 LSP 引用检查逐个确认后,把删除任务交给多个并行 agent 执行;每批自查类型检查并单独提交一次原子 commit,最后给出删除清单和验证结果。
howto.when: 当你提到 “remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup” 等关键词时触发。之后由它接管扫描、验证和删除流程。

say.text: 扫描整个项目,找出并删除无用代码
say.note: 会先扫描确认,再并行删除

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的死代码
say.note: 把扫描范围限制到该目录

say.text: 每批删除单独提交,并给出验证结果
say.note: 按文件分批提交原子 commit

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for unused imports, constants, functions and orphaned files, confirms each via LSP, then delegates removal to parallel agents. Each batch makes one atomic commit; a final report lists removals.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “remove dead code”, “dead code”, “cleanup” and similar keywords. It then takes over the scan, verification and removal flow.

say_en.text: Scan the whole project and remove unused code
say_en.note: It scans and verifies first, then removes in parallel

say_en.text: Only clean up dead code under src/utils
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Commit each batch separately and show verification results
say_en.note: One atomic commit per file batch
